description: This file defines a React component for editing a note, along with associated loader and action functions for data fetching and form submission in a Remix application.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a note by its ID after ensuring user authentication. Redirects if ID is invalid or note not found.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to update a note by ID, with error handling for validation and failed updates.

methods.name: default
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing form, with data loaded via loader and submission handled via action.
